content:
The maintainer and reviewer community are happy to announce a new weekly review/triage meeting for mathlib. Mathlib is in some sense a victim of its own success; there are currently over 1170 open PRs and even though there are many maintainers, most of them are holding down full-time jobs rather than being paid to maintain mathlib, so ultimately this number slowly rises over time. A little-known fact is that anyone is welcome to review a PR; take a look at the current state of things on the #queueboard .

The meetings will take place on Mondays at times which will move around from week to week. I initially plan to have 9 meetings (which will take us through to the end of Imperial College's term), starting 1 week from today, and we'll see how it goes from there. The meetings will have various goals: to find PRs where progress has stalled and to try and get them moving, to find PRs which are ready to go and to merge them, and to find PRs which have not received much attention and to suggest possible reviewers for them. Please feel free to come along if you are interested in the PR process and would like to see reviewing in action.

The first two meetings are

2025-01-20T09:00:00Z and
2025-01-27T14:00:00Z

(this should be displaying in your own time zone) and more information (including the Zoom link and future schedule) will be posted in the discussion thread here; if you have any questions please feel free to ask them there.
